root.label: Sequence containers
root.note: Five containers that differ in where elements live; guarantees follow from layout.

children.label: Layouts
children.note: Storage shape decides complexity, invalidation and exception behavior.

children.label: vector
children.note: One contiguous block with spare capacity; data() works.

children.label: deque
children.note: Fixed-size blocks behind an index; random access but not contiguous.

children.label: list and forward_list
children.note: One node per element; forward_list has no size() and only _after operations.

children.label: array
children.note: Elements live inside the object; fixed size, no allocation.

children.label: Growth and capacity
children.note: Only vector has capacity; the growth factor is unspecified.

children.label: push_back amortized O(1)
children.note: Capacity grows geometrically, so appending is amortized constant time.

children.label: reserve
children.note: Raises capacity without creating elements; later insertions do not reallocate until capacity is exceeded.

children.label: shrink_to_fit
children.note: A non-binding request to drop spare capacity; the implementation may ignore it.

children.label: Relocation on growth
children.note: Growth must keep the strong guarantee for copyable types.

children.label: move_if_noexcept
children.note: Elements are moved only if their move is noexcept or they cannot be copied.

children.label: Mark moves noexcept
children.note: A missing noexcept silently turns reallocation into copying.

children.label: Inserting elements
children.note: Construction in place versus passing a finished object.

children.label: emplace_back
children.note: Forwards arguments to a constructor, including explicit ones, and returns a reference since C++17.

children.label: push_back
children.note: Copies or moves an existing element; cannot use an explicit conversion.

children.label: insert_range, append_range
children.note: C++23 range members; insert_range returns an iterator, append_range returns void.

children.label: What stays put
children.note: Which references and iterators survive common operations.

children.label: deque end insertion
children.note: Invalidates iterators but not references or pointers to existing elements.

children.label: list::splice
children.note: Relinks nodes in constant time; iterators stay valid and now belong to the destination.

children.label: Erasing and choosing
children.note: Removal helpers and a default pick.

children.label: erase and erase_if
children.note: C++20 non-member functions replace the erase-remove idiom and return the removed count.

children.label: Default to vector
children.note: Contiguous memory is cache friendly; switch only for a stated need such as stability or splice.
